description: Make a new project, when the user asks for one, and work in it; open_in_app with create (or path, to import a model file) then starts its first model, and write_project_file adds to its Files. Ask the user for a name if they gave none. Never make one only to have somewhere to work: list_projects shows the ones they have. example starts it as a copy of one of the Examples list_projects shows, named name.

example.description: Start from this example project, by name; list_projects shows the examples.

name: create_project
